title: One Heavy Job at a Time
description: Running a model locally turns a laptop into a machine that has to be scheduled. A kernel panic during an inference run, how to decode the panic's exit reason from the vendor's own header instead of guessing at it, and the habits that made recovery a twenty-minute job instead of a lost morning.
cardDesc: Local inference makes scheduling an operational decision — and a panic's exit reason is two published integers, not a guess.
principles: Give a local model run the machine to itself.
Look the panic's namespace and subcode up in the vendor's header before translating them.
Write results atomically, into a directory the system is not allowed to wipe.
